_comment: Single source of truth for every paper cited on this site. Add an entry here and it appears on any page that requests its topic or id. Fields: id (unique slug), title, authors, journal, year, section (grouping on publications.html), topics (array, drives filtering), pdf (local path or URL), doi (bare DOI), arxiv (bare id), hosted (why a local copy exists: author | oa-ccby | reading-list), extras (array of {label, href}). HOSTING POLICY: link by default; host locally only when you are an author, the paper is open access, or it belongs to a curated reading set - and always record doi or arxiv too. A locally hosted PDF must be named <id>.pdf in papers/.
